name: @suluk/stripe
description: SUPERSEDED FOR PAYMENT FLOWS by @suluk/payments (the provider-agnostic seam, C048) — use that for charge/refund/customer/off-session. This package remains ONLY for the pieces not yet ported: the pricing primitives (proration/idempotency — @suluk/testgen's money conformance) and webhook signature verification. Do NOT reach for it for new payment work. First-class Stripe via a swappable PaymentProvider: usage-based billing (Billing Meters + meter events), customers, metered prices, subscriptions, webhooks — and a bridge from @suluk/cost to Stripe usage. CANDIDATE tooling.
